notes: Added robustness, fallback correctness, and unit test coverage stories for provider search.

FEAT-1-STORY-24.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema Validation Hardening
FEAT-1-STORY-24.description: Enhance Pydantic models to enforce strict validation of provider search inputs (specialty, location, radius) and outputs, including edge cases such as missing location, malformed queries, and empty results.

FEAT-1-STORY-25.title: Vector-to-Taxonomy Fallback Decision Logic
FEAT-1-STORY-25.description: Implement and validate decision thresholds for triggering taxonomy fallback when vector search confidence is low, ensuring deterministic and explainable fallback behavior.

FEAT-1-STORY-26.title: Provider Search Unit Tests for Core Service Logic
FEAT-1-STORY-26.description: Create unit tests covering provider_search_service including vector search execution, taxonomy fallback, and location filtering branches with mocked MongoDB and embedding client.

FEAT-1-STORY-27.title: Specialty Identification Integration with Provider Search
FEAT-1-STORY-27.description: Integrate specialty_service dual-pipeline (regex + vector) into provider search flow to ensure accurate NUCC code mapping and improved query interpretation before search execution.
